reviews.title: pictures disappearing after downloading, no easy way to organize photos by file name
reviews.text: several times now i’ve downloaded boards from labs that developed my photos and once the download is complete i add the photos to a new board and all the files disappear. now i have to download everything again. also it’s super frustrating to organize photos by the file name so my film rolls are in order. for some reason this app prioritizes saving files by the date added. so when i download 6-7 rolls from my developer the photos are scattered all over the place. only way you can organize photos by file name is in all boards . and its takes forever to load all the pictures. certain photos wont even display anymore. overall very frustrating experience with this app hopefully they can work out the bugs. most likely looking for an alternative app or way to transfer photos from now on

reviews.title: Unless Items are on a board they are randomly erased, yay
reviews.text: I’ve used this service for over 5 years now, and several times I’ve completely lost access to hundreds of film scans that I had on my account, for no apparent reason without any notification of any kind. Unfortunately there are many film labs that send their scans this way, do yourself a favor and save it elsewhere because it is not safe here. When contacting support, they take the roundabout way to say you are SOL if your files don’t appear on the app, no form of recovery. Wish I could circumvent having to use this app with my favorite film labs.
